narrative: 这是环境人像焦段。你能看到手、地板和门口，而这张脸依然属于一个真实的人，而不是一幅壁画。
报道式的室内空间、街头覆盖镜头，以及行走式的主镜头都活在这个焦段里，因为房间在这里是一个“搭档”，而不是特效。当空间应该“攻击”这张脸，或者这张脸应该抹去空间时，这不是合适的工具。
靠得更近的14mm会让近景膨胀变形；85mm人像镜头（85mm Portrait）则会把房间融化成一层层堆叠的色块。
如果这个节拍是大多数叙事性的对话，再带一点额外的世界信息，35mm中广角（35mm Moderate Wide）是更安静的默认选择。
how: 先确定站位：通常退后几英尺，而不是贴到鼻尖前。这样一来，24mm就能在全画幅或Super 35传感器上纳入一片宽裕的视野，透视拉伸也只是中等程度。
除非等级关系是重点，否则让摄影机保持接近眼睛的高度；一个低机位的24mm依然会因为视野范围而让人物显得英雄化，而不是因为某种“权力宣言”。手部和前景家具会显得比较大，所以要有意识地安排它们的位置。
提示词：24mm wide on [Subject], environmental portrait, body in space, moderate stretch, reportage coverage.
when: 当一个人和他所处的地方必须共享画面、谁也不能占上风时使用它：厨房里的一个士兵、街道上的一个行人。不要用它来假冒14mm那种侵入感，或者85mm那种孤立感。
vs: 14mm超广角（14mm Ultra-Wide）在近距离拍摄时会夸大近远物体的大小对比，直到房间开始“攻击”画面；35mm中广角展示的世界更少，拉伸也更少，是叙事者惯常向内收一步的选择。
在同一站位上用50mm标准镜头（50mm Normal）会裁掉环境信息；变形宽银幕镜头（Anamorphic）是一套挤压光学系统，而不是一个更宽的24mm。
examples_film: 《人类之子》（Children of Men）常常用一种依然能读出地理关系的中广角，来覆盖身处险境房间里的人物。《拆弹部队》（The Hurt Locker）在街道和室内空间里做着类似的工作：人和地方并重，谁也不是海报式的主角。
借鉴的是这种“共享空间”的语法，而不是照搬某一张静态画面。
mistakes: 最常被搞混的近邻是14mm超广角，或者35mm中广角。14mm的破绽是逼近的前景和卡通感的画面边缘。
35mm的破绽是一个更逼仄的房间，环境信息被降级。解决办法：退后几英尺站位，保持全身或四分之三身形，加上可读的建筑信息，让拉伸程度保持适中。

faq.a: 这是一支中等广角镜头，能在没有极端近远夸张对比的情况下，同时容纳一个人和其环境中可用的信息量。身体和地方共享同一个画面。
24mm纳入更多建筑信息，拉伸也更多一点；35mm是常见的叙事收紧一档的选择：依然显得有人味，但房间信息更少。24mm是报道式的空间，35mm是默认的覆盖焦段。
当这个节拍是“人加地方”、谁也不能占上风时使用它。跳过它，如果你要拍近距离人像，或者超广角式的侵入感。

faq.q: How do I prompt 24mm wide for AI image or video?
faq.a: 写：24mm wide on [Subject], environmental portrait, body in space, moderate stretch, reportage coverage。点名这个房间。禁止鱼眼式的弧形畸变和长焦式的景深衰减。

narrative: This is the environmental portrait length. You can see the hands, the floor, and the doorway, and the face still belongs to a human rather than a mural.

Reportage interiors, street coverage, and walking masters live here because the room is a partner, not a special effect. It is the wrong tool when the space should attack the face, or when the face should erase the space.
A closer 14mm will balloon the near ground. An 85mm Portrait will melt the room into stacked color.
If the beat is most narrative talk with a little extra world, 35mm Moderate Wide is the quieter default.
how: Stand first: usually a few feet back, not on the nose. 24mm then includes a generous field with only moderate perspective stretch on a full-frame or Super 35 sensor.

Keep the camera closer to eye height unless rank is the point; a low 24mm will still heroic the figure because of the field, not because of a power slogan. Hands and foreground furniture will read large, so place them on purpose.
Prompt: 24mm wide on [Subject], environmental portrait, body in space, moderate stretch, reportage coverage.
when: Use it when a person plus their place must share the frame, neither winning: a soldier in a kitchen, a walker in a street. Do not use it to fake 14mm intrusion or 85mm isolation.
vs: 14mm Ultra-Wide from close exaggerates near-to-far size until the room attacks. 35mm Moderate Wide shows less world and less stretch, the usual storyteller step inward.
50mm Normal from the same stand crops the environment. Anamorphic is a squeeze system, not a wider 24mm.
examples_film: Children of Men often covers bodies in threatened rooms at a wide-normal that still lets geography read. The Hurt Locker does similar work in streets and interiors: person plus place, neither a poster.
Use that grammar of shared space, not a matching still.
mistakes: The usual wrong cousin is 14mm Ultra-Wide or 35mm Moderate Wide. The 14mm tell is a looming foreground and cartoon edges.
The 35mm tell is a tighter room with the environment demoted. Fix: stand a few feet back, hold full body or three-quarter plus readable architecture, keep stretch moderate.

faq.a: It is a moderately wide lens that holds a person and a usable amount of their environment without extreme near-to-far exaggeration. Body and place share the frame.
24mm includes more architecture and a little more stretch. 35mm is the common narrative step tighter: still human, less room. 24mm is reportage space. 35mm is default coverage.
Use it when the beat is person plus place, neither winning. Skip it for close portraits and for ultra-wide intrusion.

faq.q: How do I prompt 24mm wide for AI image or video?
faq.a: Write: 24mm wide on [Subject], environmental portrait, body in space, moderate stretch, reportage coverage. Name the room. Forbid fisheye bowing and telephoto falloff.
